context: A police officer briefs a reporter on a regional case
purpose: Teach: 宮城/大島/荒川/金子/今井/市川/片山/熊谷

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 宮城県内の事件、捜査が大島町まで広がっています。
lines.en: The Miyagi Prefecture case—the investigation has expanded as far as Oshima town.
lines.style: Measured, official opening. Steady pace. The facts delivered without inflection, but not cold. A briefing tone—professional and controlled.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 荒川沿いに、有力な目撃情報があったんですよね。
lines.en: There were some solid eyewitness accounts along the Arakawa, weren't there?
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly. Genuine curiosity mixed with deference to authority. Careful enunciation—he's thinking as he speaks. Not rushing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。被害者の金子さん、保護を続けています。
lines.en: Yes. We're continuing to keep the victim, Kaneko-san, in protective custody.
lines.style: Consistent tempo, slightly lower register than before. The pronoun 'we' carries quiet responsibility. Careful articulation on the victim's name—respect implied.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今井被疑者、市川市内に居住していたんですね。
lines.en: So the suspect Imai was living in Ichikawa, then.
lines.style: Thoughtful, testing understanding aloud. A small pause before the name—connecting details. Gentle probe, not interrogation. Asking as a peer, not a questioner.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。共犯と疑われる片山も、熊谷で身柄確保しました。
lines.en: Yes. We also apprehended the suspected accomplice Katayama in Kumagaya.
lines.style: Final statement, delivered with quiet finality. Slight weight on 'apprehended'—the fact lands. Professional closure. Slower at the end, letting the information settle.
